job.job_title: Macros India Junior Analyst , Process analyst
job.job_description:
Indore - night shift

Essential Duties

Develop process automation tools and processes using VBA Excel Macros, Python, SQL, PowerBI, and other tools as needed.
Enhance and maintain existing VBA Excel Macros, Python programs and other tools as needed.
Work with stakeholders to uncover all requirements and develop iteratively towards a user accepted product.
Develop tools that are easy to maintain and enhance over time.
Address and find solutions to bugs and issues in VBA Macros, Python programs, SQL queries, PowerBI dashboards, etc. in a timely manner.
Write documentation for new and existing process automation tools and processes.
Assists in uncovering issues, evaluates various courses of action, and promotes the best option for resolution.
Becomes aware on how to locate and define new process improvement opportunities
Acquires data from primary and secondary data sources and assists in analyzing and interpreting trends or patterns in complex data sets.
Effectively use data visualization, in summaries and or dashboards to enhance translation of data and findings.
Performs data profiling and root cause analysis to identify and understand anomalies
Aids in preparing reports on data summaries, changes, and trends for use by management. Works collaboratively to provide assessment and recommendations to management.
Works to help resolve issues arising from internal department functions, or as brought forth by internal or external customers to assigned department.
Tracks issues to resolution within department and in partnership with other groups.
Monitors overall workflow to ensure timely completion of projects and daily work requirements.
Assists with special projects within assigned department or as part of cross-functional teams as required or assigned.
Works as part of a team to determine areas of risk as new or changed processes are implemented.
Able to use a standard process to develop quality software from requirements to deployment. Use tracking software to log progress during each step.

Other Skills:

Intermediate to Advanced development skill in VBA for Excel. Must be able to make moderately complex macros from start to finish using VBA including UI and backend.
Must be able to make understandable code with good comments and design in a way that promotes future enhancements, easy bug-fixing, and code re-use.
Requires intermediate to advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel).
Intermediate to Advanced skills in Python software development.
Basic to intermediate skills in SQL query development.
Experience with git or similar version control system.
Able to test and debug code independently.
Able to design and build from a user perspective.
Able to develop software independently based on a set of requirements.
Able to design and build iteratively (Agile development).
Able to work with stakeholders to define clear requirements and test cases.
Comfortable researching unknown topics and finding solutions to programming problems independently.
Comfortable working independently and in a team environment.
Inquisitive nature and unafraid to ask questions.
Growth mindset (continuous learning).
Strong time management skills.
Strong analytical skills.
Comfortable with written and spoken communication skills.
Strong organizational and note-taking skills and a propensity for accuracy is crucial.
